review.identity: Implementer: bunny-alpha-2/bunny-alpha-2 (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash, Rally #774 implement claim of 2026-10-17). Reviewer: bunny-alpha-2/bunny-alpha-2 (the same agent name and model, a fresh review session, Rally #774 review claim of 2026-10-17), so this is not an independent review and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. The reviewer re-derived the Objective census from the installation, re-read both screen scripts and the engine image facts, repeated two mutation probes and corrected the stale statements it found; the reviewer's checks are recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-17-f47-d2-objective-replay-and-mementos.md.
review.method: acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the production scrapbook discovery and audit over that installation, the production baseline's campaign rows, rustc and Cargo.lock; validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. The consumer trace is cs_content::scrapbook::discover + audit, whose objective census (objective_rules) reads the Objective position of GOSDATA/ASSETS/crimson.rof's ASSETS/SCRAPBOOK.CSV member through the production ROF mount and keyed-list reader and binds it to the campaign mission its page names. Two independent derivations share only the byte readers: a second parse of the table that re-counts the numbered/special positions and the Snap_<page>_<n> agreements without calling objective_rules, and a second read of ASSETS/SCRIPTS/SCRAPBOOK_TOC.SCRIPT and MOMENTOSELECTION.SCRIPT that re-reads the native command numbers its bytes spell (2104/2405/2409/2411 and 2150). Capability coverage is checked, not assumed: the retail acceptance test must be present and pass in the recorded log. Implementer mutation probes on this branch: an off-by-one page->mission index fails the synthetic binding test on three bound rules; forcing the snapshot agreement true fails it on the agreeing count; dropping the snapshot census fails it on the snapshot count. Reviewer (bunny-alpha-2, a fresh session but the same agent name as the implementer, so not independent): re-exported the decoded members through the production ROF decoder, re-derived the whole census with a throwaway Python reader that shares nothing with cs_content, re-read both screen scripts and the engine image offsets, re-read the two missions' OBJECTIVE runs by identifier, repeated two mutation probes of the binding and corrected the stale statements it found. LIMITATION: Whether the original engine gates an item's visibility on the numbered objective its `Objective` position names is native behavior this engine has not decoded; the position is measured to name an objective, and no script reads the table's `Objective`. Affected content: every unlock path, hidden page and reward claim in F47 and F42. Resolving tasks: F38 (native behaviour bindings) and F13/F07-D (mission language). LIMITATION: What a replay launches is native: the table-of-contents replay control passes a list index to native command 2104, and the table documents no mission field. Affected content: every replay link's mission and variant in F47-C's launch. Resolving task: F38. LIMITATION: The memento set, its order and its unlock state are native: the memento-selection script reads and writes its picture through native command 2150 and the table holds no memento record. Affected content: the cabin memento choice (spec F47 non-negotiable 5) and any `EntryKind::Memento`. Resolving tasks: F38 and F45's cabin screen work. LIMITATION: The meaning of the 14 special `Objective` positions is unmeasured: 0 is the initial page and the four negative positions name no numbered objective. Affected content: the visibility of the four items that carry them. Resolving task: F38. LIMITATION: No runtime consumes a measured `ScrapbookObjectiveRule` yet: it is data a declared catalog can project, and the runtime declares no scrapbook entry at all. Affected content: the whole scrapbook UI's data. Resolving tasks: #773 / F47-C2 on top of #760 / F47-C1. LIMITATION: No original executable ran in this session; `retail` is file access, and the engine's snapshot naming was read from the image as strings and offsets only. Affected content: every fidelity and original-behaviour claim for F47. Resolving task: REF-OWNER-FIRST-CAPTURE / #358.
